question: Amaravati stupa is situated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Amaravati Stupa** is located in the state of **Andhra Pradesh**, India.
 
• It is an important **Buddhist monument** and a significant archaeological site.
 
• The stupa was originally built during the reign of the **Mauryan Emperor Ashoka** in the 3rd century BCE.
